column10: According to the information released by Guizhou Government on Jan 23,2021, it has been 344 consecutive days since last local confirmed case was cured, and 301 consecutive days since last imported case. Therefore, no evidence suggests school closing measures are in place in Guizhou.     On Dec 31, 2020, Ministry of Education gave more instructions on control measures around the coming winter holiday, which was also followed by the Sichuan Government. The policy is mainly about how to effectively and safely advance the vocation and new semester, but without closing requirements.     However, there is evidence conveying some significant differences compared to usual, for example, Guizhou University made special managements for the coming vocation last December (only related news can be found on the school website). column42: Novel coronavirus pneumonia cases were confirmed in Liaoning province from 0 to 24 in May 16th, all of which were asymptomatic infections, and 2 cases were newly diagnosed in Anhui Province, and no new cases were cured or discharged.  Announcement issued in Hubei  Novel coronavirus pneumonia in Enshi is reported in the latest bulletin of COVID-19 prevention and control headquarters in May 16th. The latest bulletin of the COVID-19 prevention and control command in May 16th showed that 38 people (18 people in Badong County, 10 in Lichuan, 6 in Enshi, 1 in Xuanen County, 2 in Xianfeng County, 1 in Jianshi county) had been implemented.  Circular of Huangzhou District of Huanggang City on the detection of a close contact in Feixi district on May 13, 2021, a close contact of a confirmed case in Feixi entered Huangzhou district. At 16:00 on May 14, Huangzhou CDC conducted a centralized isolation medical observation; From the 14th to the 16th, three nucleic acid tests and one antibody test were carried out successively, and the results were all negative. Ten close contacts in Huangzhou District have been identified, and centralized isolation medical observation measures have been implemented. The nucleic acid test results of 10 people are all negative, and the antibody test results are normal. The close contacts outside the area have sent letters to the territory for investigation and control. In addition, 93 environmental samples were collected from newbinkai Hotel and idyllic Chinese fast food chain, and the nucleic acid test results were negative. column10: In view of the current COVID-19 prevention and control situation, universities in Wuhan have enhanced preventions and controls for COVID-19:  (1) Wuhan University, Huazhong University of Science and Technology and other universities have made it clear that students should accumulate at least 14 days' health record before returning to school. column56: A-key workers  On January 17, 2021, the Jilin Provincial Health Commission held a press conference to announce that Jilin Province is organizing the new crown vaccination work for key populations,including A and B. Currently, there are five types of key populations vaccinated against the new crown: First, the port line of imported cold chain goods Customs inspection and quarantine personnel, port loading and unloading, handling, transportation and other related personnel; second, international and domestic transportation personnel; third, personnel working and studying abroad for business or private purposes, and border port staff who are facing a higher risk of overseas epidemics; The fourth is medical and health personnel; the fifth is urban operation guarantee personnel.     Jilin Province has carried out the new crown vaccine for key populations on a voluntary and free principle. The vaccinated population should be between 18-59 years old and there is no contraindication to vaccination. Currently, Jilin Province has raised 177 million yuan in funds to purchase the new crown vaccine and has ordered 1.324 million doses. A support mechanism for medical institutions and vaccination units above the second level has been established to ensure vaccination safety, and vaccination work is proceeding in an orderly manner.    http://web.archive.org/web/20210604093521/https://baijiahao.baidu.com/s?id=1689294564763295055&wfr=spider&for=pc  https://web.archive.org/web/20210406123753/https://baijiahao.baidu.com/s?id=1689294564763295055&wfr=spider&for=pc

Foreigners who have not participated in the social security and medical insurance of Jilin Province and the municipality need to be vaccinated at their own expense if they wish to vaccinate. People who have traveled to or returned from medium-high risk areas and their counties (cities, districts or banners) shall be quarantined at home or in centralized areas, and nucleic acid tests shall be conducted every three days until they have been away from risk areas for 14 days. column10: On April 29, the epidemic prevention and control headquarters of Ruili City issued a notice on the adjustment of the epidemic risk level, which means there is no high-risk area in Ruili.    At present, the entry of non-native personnel and vehicles into Ruili is not restricted. All medium-risk areas, community containment sites and centralized isolation sites will continue to strictly implement the current containment management measures. All jewelry and jade trading places, network broadcast rooms, cinemas, Internet cafes, KTV, chess and card rooms, gyms, training institutions, sports venues, places of religious activities and other places of gathering personnel are temporarily closed; All kinds of schools and education and training institutions are temporarily closed; Catering enterprises implement online ordering and offline delivery, allowing packaging to take away, temporarily not open to in-room food. Government affairs centers, financial insurance, water, electricity and communication outlets and other service Windows, public transport, farmers' markets, hotels, logistics, express delivery, beauty salons and other services can resume business under the strict implementation of the prevention and control measures,  taking necessary measures to control the flow of people.    Continue to adhere to ventilation and disinfection, flow restriction, temperature measurement, code scanning, wearing masks and other measures, strictly implement the regular nucleic acid screening of key personnel, and effectively strengthen community management. Closed management will continue to be implemented in Dubian villages.    See the website of People's Government of Yunnan Province:  https://archive.vn/D2BnD

column10: The epidemic prevention and control headquarters of Ruili City issued a notice of risk level adjustment on May 4, so far, the middle and high risk areas in Ruili City were cleared to zero.  At present, the entry of non-native personnel and vehicles into Ruili is not restricted. The notice allows relevant personnel to pass through from 8:00 to 22:00 every day, and is not allowed to pass through other time periods. Detaining Chinese nationals and permanent residents can leave the area by taking their temperature and scanning the code with the negative proof of effective nucleic acid test within 7 days. Government affairs centers, financial insurance, water, electricity and communication outlets and other service Windows, public transportation, farmers' markets, hotels, logistics, express delivery, beauty salons and other services will resume business under the strict implementation of prevention and control measures, and necessary measures will be taken to control the flow of people.  The epidemic prevention and control headquarters of Ruili City asked to continue to adhere to ventilation and disinfection, flow restriction, temperature measurement, code scanning, wearing masks and other measures to effectively strengthen community management, and continue to implement the closed management of the villages in Dubian.
